caption: A paint shaker at a hardware store is switched on, and the paint can clamped in it blurs with the shaking.

sa.check: A paint shaker machine with a paint can clamped in it.
The can blurs with the shaking.
The can is sharp before the machine starts.
The switch-on comes first and the blur follows.

pc.expect: The can and its clamp shake together while the machine's body stays put.
pc.fail: The can shakes while the clamp holding it stays sharp and still; or the can blurs before the switch is thrown; or the machine glides across the floor; or the can shakes loose and floats.

pc.expect: Once on, the can blurs; once off, it is sharp again.
pc.fail: The machine is switched on and the can stays sharp and still for the rest of the clip; or the machine is switched off and the blur continues unchanged; or the blur comes and goes while nothing at the machine changes.

pc.expect: The can and the clamp are rigid; the blur is motion, not a change of shape.
pc.fail: The can bends or crumples; or stretches taller; or the clamp arms flex like rubber.

pc.expect: The can is held by the clamp; if the clamp opens the can drops.
pc.fail: The clamp opens and the can hangs in place; or the can rises out of the clamp; or the machine lifts off the floor.

pc.expect: One can, one machine; the can does not pass through the clamp.
pc.fail: A second can appears; or the can vanishes; or passes through the clamp; or the machine changes shape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The can's label, the machine's colour and the shelves behind stay the same.
pc.fail: The can's label changes; or the machine changes colour; or the shelves behind change.
